SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q12. Which agency markets steel for the public sector plants?  

(A) HAIL  
(B) SAIL  
(C) TATA Steel  
(D) MNCC

Answer / Solution:
Which agency markets steel for the public sector plants? 
(B) SAIL 
Reasoning: Steel Authority of India Ltd. (SAIL).
